title: Workana
bio: Workana is a freelance marketplace focused on Latin America where companies hire remote professionals for programming, design and marketing work.

title: WorldRemit
bio: WorldRemit is an online money transfer service for sending funds abroad to bank accounts, mobile money wallets and cash pickup locations.

title: WP Engine
bio: American managed WordPress hosting company providing hosting, staging, security and performance tools for WordPress and WooCommerce sites.

title: Wuzzuf
bio: Wuzzuf is an Egyptian online recruitment platform where employers post jobs and professionals and graduates apply for positions.

title: Wyzant
bio: American online marketplace where students find and book independent tutors for in-person or online lessons in academic and other subjects.

title: Yemeksepeti
bio: Turkish online food ordering app for restaurant delivery, groceries and other products, owned by Delivery Hero.

title: Yoco
bio: Yoco provides card machines, point-of-sale software and payment tools that help small businesses in South Africa accept card payments.

title: Yulu
bio: Indian shared electric two-wheeler service renting e-bikes and scooters through an app in Indian cities.

title: Zepto
bio: Indian quick-commerce app delivering groceries, fruit and vegetables, snacks and household essentials from dark stores within minutes.

title: Zerodha
bio: Indian discount stock broker for stocks, mutual funds and derivatives.

title: Zipcar
bio: Car-sharing service that lets members rent cars by the hour or day from reserved spots, owned by Avis Budget Group.

title: Zocdoc
bio: American online service that lets patients search for doctors by specialty and insurance, read reviews and book appointments online.

title: Zoopla
bio: British property website for sales and rentals.
